summary: Iter 63: Staff Hiring Marketplace + CCTV Flash Offer end-to-end tested. All 19 backend pytest cases pass; salon-admin, public /jobs, and super-admin frontend flows all pass. No blocking issues found.
critical_code_review_comments: hiring.py: registry-employee phone lookup is a full-scan async-for loop over registry_employees; fine at current volume but should use a normalized-phone indexed field for scale.
hiring.py my_requests() N+1: one job_applications.find per request; acceptable up to ~50 requests but consider $lookup aggregation.
JobsBoard modal: wrong-phone toast (sonner) works, but no inline error inside modal — user sees toast only. Consider persistent inline error for accessibility.
Field-wrapped inputs on Login: data-testid is on <input>, so type() works but page.fill() also works — no bug, just noting testing quirk observed.
test_credentials: loaded from /app/memory/test_credentials.md (admin@miracurl.com, super@miracurl.com); registry phone 9998887777 (Ravi Test Kumar)
seed_data_creation: Backend test creates a fresh hiring request per session (role TEST_Beautician_<uuid>) and marks Ravi Test Kumar hired → parent closes. UI test also created a hiring request via the modal (default role) and applied via /jobs. Non-destructive to existing Hair Stylist + Ravi trial_scheduled row and today's daily/flash offers.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend tests are in /app/backend/tests/test_iter63_hiring_flash.py. IMPORTANT: TestPublicJobsAndHQ class must remain a SINGLE class — xdist loadscope pins its tests to one worker so the module-scoped fresh_request_id fixture stays consistent across public/jobs apply → HQ overview → trial → hire flow. Splitting them across classes causes cross-worker fixture drift (initially observed: TestHQ ran on gw0 while apply happened on gw1's fresh id). Flash offer flow: /api/day-offers/flash-alert returns {alert:{status:'suggested'}, offer:{kind:'flash', ...}}; /api/day-offers/today returns {offer:{kind:'daily', status:'accepted', title:'Weekend Indulgence Package', ...}}. Do NOT call /api/day-offers/accept or /api/cctv/analyze-frame — image gen/vision LLM costs.
